name: Real Estate Agent, Broker and Analyst
description: ⚠⚠⚠ The licence to sell property in Florida is 63 classroom hours — about a week and a half — and employers report 52% accepting a high school diploma and 22% less than that. ⚠⚠ Meanwhile Florida's universities award 408 real estate credentials a year, 138 of them MASTER'S. Those two facts describe different jobs that share a word, and choosing between them is what this page is for.
credentialNote: ⚠⚠⚠ THE ENTIRE EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENT IS 63 CLASSROOM HOURS. Section 475.17, F.S. caps the sales associate pre-licensing course at 63 classroom hours of 50 minutes each, inclusive of examination — roughly 52 actual hours. Add the state examination, fingerprinting and a background check and you are licensed to handle the largest financial transaction most families ever make. ⚠ There is no degree requirement, no experience requirement, and no apprenticeship. ⚠⚠ THE BROKER STEP IS EXPERIENCE, NOT EDUCATION. A broker needs a course capped at 72 classroom hours, post-licensure education, AND an active sales associate licence for at least 24 MONTHS during the preceding 5 years — in Florida or another state, or in the employ of a government agency. ⚠ That two-year clock is the real gate, and it is worth $20,390: brokers earn a $73,220 median against agents' $52,830. ⚠⚠⚠ AND THE INCOME FIGURE NEEDS READING CAREFULLY. Real estate sales is commission work and agents are overwhelmingly self-employed. The $52,830 median describes people who reported earnings as agents — it does not describe the licensees who earned little, gave up and stopped being counted. ⚠ Treat it as the middle of the people who STAYED, and budget for a first year with no income at all.
bodyHtml:
⚠⚠⚠ One word, two careers

Sales agent / brokerReal estate finance and analysis
What it takes⚠⚠ 63 classroom hours + examinationa bachelor's or master's degree
Employers report52% high school, ⚠ 22% LESS than high school—
Pay⚠ commission, $52,830 mediansalaried
Florida supplyanyone who takes the course⚠ 408 credentials a year, 138 of them master's
Where it is taughtREE1040 at 5 STATE COLLEGESREE3043 at 7 and REE4204 at 8, all UNIVERSITIES

⚠⚠⚠ The degree is not the sales licence and the sales licence is not the degree. Florida's academic programmes serve commercial real estate — finance, investment analysis, development, appraisal, portfolio management — which is salaried work with different employers and different hours. 138 master's degrees a year is the tell.

⚠ Plenty of people do both, and a degree makes an agent better at the analytical parts. But nobody needs one to be licensed, and paying four years for a credential the job does not ask for is the commonest mistake available here.

The occupations

RoleSOC2025 medianEmployedOpenings/yrGrowth 2024–34
Real estate sales agent41-9022$52,830420,90036,600average (3–4%)
✅ Real estate broker41-9021✅ $73,220111,3009,700average (3–4%)

⚠⚠ $20,390 separates agent from broker, and the gate is two years of licensed practice rather than any additional education. That is an unusually clear and reachable step — and unlike most ladders on this site it costs time rather than tuition.

⚠⚠⚠ What the median does not tell you

Real estate sales is commission work and agents are overwhelmingly self-employed. The $52,830 median describes people who reported earnings as agents.

⚠⚠⚠ It does not describe the people who got licensed, earned almost nothing, and stopped. The barrier to entry is a week and a half of classes, so a great many people cross it, and the ones who do not make it simply disappear from the statistics. Read $52,830 as the middle of the people who STAYED.

⚠⚠ The practical consequence: budget for a first year with no income. Commission arrives at closing, closings take months, and the first one is the slowest. Every experienced agent will tell you the same thing, and it is the single most useful sentence on this page.

⚠ And treat it as a business from day one — you will be self-employed, paying quarterly estimated tax, buying your own insurance, and funding your own marketing. Nothing in the 63-hour course covers that.

⚠⚠ The broker step is the one worth planning

Section 475.17 requires a broker applicant to have held an active sales associate licence for at least 24 months during the preceding 5 years — in Florida, in another state, or in the employ of a government agency — plus post-licensure education and a course capped at 72 classroom hours.

⚠⚠ Two things follow that are worth knowing early. The 24 months must sit inside a FIVE-YEAR window, so a licence left dormant does not accumulate credit toward it. And out-of-state experience counts, which matters in a state where a large share of licensees arrive from somewhere else.

⚠ If the analytical side is what interests you

Florida's universities teach a serious commercial real estate curriculum and almost nobody outside it knows:

CourseCarriers
REE4204 Real Estate Finance8 — FAMU, FAU, FGCU, FIU, FSU, UCF, UF, UNF
REE3043 Real Estate Principles7 universities
REE4303 Real Estate Finance and Investment6
REE4103 Real Estate Appraisal5

⚠⚠ That is investment analysis, valuation, development finance and portfolio work — salaried jobs at institutions, funds, developers and appraisal firms. The prefix barely exists below the 3000 level: 77 undergraduate course numbers against 51 graduate ones, and only REE1040 at five state colleges sits at the practical end.

⚠ If this is the half that interests you, a finance degree may serve you better than a real estate one — it is taught far more widely, it is more portable if you change your mind, and the real estate courses can be taken as electives on top.

Necessary skills

  • Prospecting. The constraint is not knowing the market, it is having people to call. Agents who fail mostly fail here.
  • Negotiating between parties who both think you work for them, while holding a fiduciary duty to one.
  • Contract literacy. O*NET lists preparing sales contracts and legal documents among the core tasks, and errors are expensive and personal.
  • Pricing property honestly when the seller wants a higher number and the listing is yours to win or lose.
  • Running a small business — cash flow across irregular commission, self-employment tax, marketing spend.
  • Persistence across a long dry start, which is the real filter and nothing in the course prepares you for it.

Advice

⚠⚠⚠ Do not buy a degree to become a sales agent. 63 classroom hours is the requirement, employers report 52% accepting a high school diploma, and the money you do not spend on tuition is the money that funds your first commission-free year.

⚠⚠ Budget twelve months of living costs before you start. This is the advice every experienced agent gives and the one most new licensees ignore.

⚠ Plan the broker licence from day one. 24 months of active licence inside a five-year window, and it is worth $20,390 on the median. Out-of-state experience counts.

⚠⚠ If the analysis is what appeals rather than the selling, go to the other half of the industry deliberately. Real estate finance, appraisal and development are salaried, taught at Florida's universities, and reached through a finance or real estate degree — and 138 people a year take a master's in it.

And pick your brokerage on training, not on split. A higher commission share of nothing is nothing, and the first two years are where the 24-month clock and the survival odds are both decided.

programs.note: ⚠⚠ The DEGREE side, which is not the sales licence — 8 Florida public institutions, 408 credentials, 180 bachelor's and 138 master's in finance, investment, development and appraisal. FIU 135, FSU 88, UCF 62. ⚠ Read its degrees note on why the course catalogue splits the same way the industry does.

⚠⚠⚠ For the analytical half, effectively the same subject and a more portable degree. Real estate finance, valuation and investment analysis are finance applied to buildings, and finance is taught far more widely in Florida. ⚠ Take the REE courses as electives on top.

⚠⚠ The development route, and underadvertised. A developer needs to know what a building costs and how long it takes, and this is where Florida teaches it. ⚠ A genuine pairing for anyone whose interest is in creating property rather than transacting it.

⚠ The substitute most people in commercial real estate actually hold. A real estate degree exists at 8 Florida institutions; general business is everywhere and reaches the same roles with a concentration or the REE courses as electives.

⚠ Named for the sales half. Residential real estate is a customer-acquisition business and the agents who last are the ones who build a pipeline. ⚠⚠ Nothing in the 63-hour pre-licensing course teaches that, which is a large part of why most new licensees leave.

⚠⚠ Named because a licensed sales associate IS a self-employed small business, and most new agents do not realise it until the first tax year. ⚠ Florida teaches short business certificates at 30 institutions, and one of those is a better use of a semester than another real estate course.

courses.reason: ⚠⚠ Real Estate Principles and Practices — 5 Florida institutions (Broward, Eastern Florida, Indian River, Pasco-Hernando, St Petersburg), ALL state colleges. The practical, lower-division entry to the subject and the only REE course that lives at the sales end.
courses.variantNote: ⚠ This is college credit, not the state pre-licensing course. The 63-hour course required by s. 475.17 is a separate, Commission-approved course — check whether your college's version is approved for licensure or is academic credit only.

courses.reason: ⚠ Real Estate Principles — 7 institutions, ALL universities. The degree-track version of the same subject, and the gateway to the finance sequence.
courses.variantNote: ⚠⚠ Note the level split: REE1040 at five state colleges is lower division and REE3043 at seven universities is upper division. They are not interchangeable toward a baccalaureate.

courses.reason: ⚠⚠ Real Estate Finance — 8 institutions (FAMU, FAU, FGCU, FIU, FSU, UCF, UF, UNF), the most widely carried REE course in Florida. The core of the commercial half of the industry.
Real Estate Finance and Investment — 6 institutions. Investment analysis, cap rates, discounted cash flow — the analytical work that pays a salary rather than a commission.

Real Estate Appraisal — 5 institutions. ⚠ Appraisal is a separately licensed Florida profession with its own education and experience requirements, and this course is the academic foundation for it rather than the licence.

Introduction to Residential Property Management — 3 institutions (Broward, Eastern Florida, Valencia). ⚠ Named because property management is steady salaried work in the same industry, and it is far less discussed than sales.
Internship — 3 institutions (FGCU, FSU, UCF). In an industry that hires on relationships, a placement inside a firm is worth more than another course.

⚠⚠ Business Finance — the foundation the whole commercial side rests on. Time value of money, discounting and leverage are what real estate finance applies, and finance is taught at far more Florida institutions than real estate is.
courses.variantNote: ⚠ Florida numbers introductory finance several ways (FIN3403, FIN3400, FIN2100). Check your catalogue.

courses.reason: ⚠ Financial Accounting — 32 institutions. Named because a sales associate is self-employed from day one: commission income, deductible expenses and quarterly estimated tax are the real first-year curriculum.
Business Law — contracts, agency and fiduciary duty. ⚠ O*NET lists preparing sales contracts among the core tasks, and an agent's errors are personal and expensive.
courses.variantNote: ⚠ Florida numbers business law several ways (BUL2241, BUL3130, BUL2131).

courses.reason: ⚠ Principles of Marketing — 24 institutions, all state colleges. Prospecting and pipeline are the actual constraint on a new agent, and this is where they are taught cheaply.
courses.variantNote: ⚠ A 2000-level course; if a baccalaureate follows, check whether your programme wants MAR3023 instead.

courses.reason: Introduction to Business — 29 institutions, the widest business course in Florida. A sensible single course for someone getting licensed rather than enrolling in a degree.
Principles of Microeconomics — 39 institutions. Supply, demand and price in the market you are about to advise people about.
Fundamentals of Speech Communication — 16 institutions. Listing presentations and negotiation are performances, and both are teachable.
English Composition I — 39 institutions. Contracts, disclosures and listing copy are written documents read adversarially.

Tasks include negotiating between buyers and sellers, advising on pricing and financing, preparing sales contracts and legal documents, and appraising properties before listing.

sources.note: 111,300 employed, median $73,220 (2025), 9,700 annual openings, growth average (3% to 4%). Education 26% bachelor's, 21% less than high school. ⚠ $20,390 above the sales agent median, and the gate is 24 months of licensed practice rather than further education.
